title.en: Process position: interconnect layers versus device layers

subtitle.en: Locate the two capacitor types from FEOL to BEOL

body.en: Metal M1 (or a lower metal layer)
MOS depends on the device layer and gate stack;

body.zh: MIM通常插入金属互连流程
body.en: MIM is usually inserted into the metal-interconnect flow

body.zh: 位置 × 成本 × 寄生
MIM远离衬底可降低部分衬底耦合，但新增层、via与走线会带来成本和寄生
body.en: Placing MIM away from the substrate reduces some substrate coupling, but added layers, vias and routing add cost and parasitics

body.zh: 量测反馈：结构截面/链路电阻 /电容WAT / 寄生提取
body.en: Measurement feedback: cross-sections / chain resistance / capacitor WAT / parasitic extraction

body.zh: 边界：MIM位于哪两层金属之间，由具体工艺平台与PDK定义。
body.en: Scope: the process platform and PDK define which two metal layers surround the MIM capacitor.
